meta.name: Lo Chudail Chali Sasural
meta.description: Lo Chudail Chali Sasural is a supernatural family sitcom and the Indian adaptation of Bewitched. Urvashi, a chudail longing for a human family, marries Aarav Patel and joins his lively Gujarati joint family. As her magic causes hilarious mishaps, Aarav struggles to protect her secret while her human-hating mother Kamini fuels the chaos. Amid magical mayhem, and family drama, love finds a way.

videos.title: E1. The Bride's Secret
videos.overview: When a chudail becomes the newest bahu of a Gujarati joint family, her hidden powers turn everyday life into an unexpected adventure.

videos.title: E2. My Wife Is A Witch
videos.overview: A forgotten truth spell turns Aarav brutally honest, but chaos erupts when he accidentally reveals Urvashi's biggest secret to the entire family.

videos.title: E3. The Truth Spell Chaos
videos.overview: Aarav's truth spell throws the Patel family into disarray as hidden truths come to light. As tensions rise and secrets are exposed, Urvashi finds herself in an increasingly difficult situation.
